series.title: His One and Only Love
series.synopsis: A dark romance following Lyla, who is rescued by billionaire Leo Adams at a casino. After becoming pregnant with his child and beginning to develop feelings for him, Lyla faces interference from Kim, who claims to be Leo's fiancee, putting Lyla's life and trust in jeopardy.

series.title: Deny Me, Dragon King
series.synopsis: Human Lyra stumbles on Dragon King Kael and shares a passionate night. Tricked by a fake prophecy, he casts her out - only for Lyra to bear his half-dragon daughter Amber. Years later, she returns seeking a healer to save her sick child. Old sparks reignite, jealous rivals plot, and hidden blood ties surface as they fight for their family and broken love.

series.title: Tempest: The Last Mecha
series.synopsis: Broken by his parents' deaths, Colt Thorne, the Mech King, hides as a lowly janitor after being saved by Freya. When Freya, the woman he secretly loves, is betrayed and forced into a lethal mech duel, Colt unleashes his hidden identity, unlocking his legendary 100% Neural Sync to command The Tempest and crush his enemies.

series.title: Step Back! I'm the Hidden King
series.synopsis: On a New York-bound flight, Arthur meets Throne Tech heiress Anya, who offers a fake marriage to escape an arranged union. Arthur refuses, yet upgrades her investment bid to $100 billion. Later dumped by his fiancee Serena, Arthur is defended by Anya. At a grand gala, Arthur reveals himself as Titan Group's CEO. He funds Anya, and the two choose to build a new life together.

series.title: I Wish It Were You
series.synopsis: Bound by a family alliance, Isabel found herself reluctantly married to a stranger named Jared. Despite being wed for a year, their encounters were so scarce they could barely recall each other's faces. As Isabel navigated her new life at work, she unexpectedly fell deeply for her boss - the billionaire Lorenzo Bellini - only to discover that the captivating Lorenzo was, in fact, her husband Jared.

series.title: Lady Diamond's Lost Heiress Returns
series.synopsis: A young woman named Bella sacrifices herself to the mafia to save her mother Maria. Twenty years later, Maria has become 'Lady Diamond,' a wealthy and influential mogul searching for her lost daughter. When Bella is betrayed and humiliated at her own wedding by her fiance Vince, Maria recognizes her daughter's birthmark and uses her power to protect Bella and destroy their enemies.
